question: How many countries have higher average generiosity over years compared to the world' average?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) FROM ( SELECT country_name, AVG(generosity) AS avg_generosity FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY country_name ) AS gen_above_avg WHERE gen_above_avg.avg_generosity > (SELECT AVG(generosity) FROM world_happiness_report)
answer: Based on the provided query results, there are 75 countries that have an average generosity score higher than the global average.
